{{Top}}
[[File:Tantive_IV_box_art.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A Corellian CR90 corvette]]
The '''corvette''' was a class of [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. They were typically small, fast, maneuverable and relatively lightly-armed. Generally large enough to be considered a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] but smaller than a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], corvettes filled a variety of roles that ranged from picket duty within large [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] to [[Star system/Legends|system]] defense and [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] escort.

The most ubiquitous model of corvette was the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], the most famous example of such being the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. The vessel served as the [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]] for [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on her [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to convince [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Corvettes saw action with nearly all [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Navy/Legends|navies]] throughout the [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Corvettes filled a comparatively inexpensive gap in the capital ship range of rebel, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] fleets and armadas. They were suitable for dealing with any [[Starship/Legends|ships]] smaller than themselves, and though they were not effective against larger ships without support, many were famous for outrunning and escaping them, thanks to their exceptional speed and maneuverability for a capital ship.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Timothy Zahn]] received at least one chastising letter from a fan regarding his use of the term "corvette" in ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the fan not realizing that well prior to being the name of a [[Wikipedia:Chevrolet Corvette|modern car]], "corvette" originated as a term for a small warship and that usage of the term was already well-established within the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe.<ref name="Heir 20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref>
